message.content:
Create a corpus of realistic, hand-written-looking test documents for exercising a YAML + Markdown code formatter. Write files ONLY under /tmp/corpus/ (create it). Do not read or modify anything under /workspace. Do not run any formatter. Just write input files. Directory layout and counts: - /tmp/corpus/yaml/ : 45 files with .yaml or .yml extensions. Cover: GitHub Actions workflows (several, with `${{ ... }}` expressions, `on:` triggers, matrix, `run: |` blocks, long single-line `run:` commands, `if:` conditions), docker-compose files (anchors `&x`/aliases `*x`, `<<: *x` merge keys, ports/env lists, quoted strings), Kubernetes manifests (multi-document with `---`, ConfigMaps with `|` blocks, long annotation strings), Helm values.yaml, Ansible playbooks/roles (Jinja `"{{ var }}"` strings, `when:` conditions, handlers, `loop:`), OpenAPI 3 specs (paths, `'200':` keys, `$ref`, long `description:` values, nested schemas, flow lists like `required: [id, name]`), mkdocs.yml (nav lists, `!!python/name:` tags, markdown_extensions), GitLab CI, CircleCI, pre-commit config, conda environment.yml, dependabot.yml, codecov.yml, .readthedocs.yaml-style, Jekyll _config.yml, Hugo config, Serverless framework, CloudFormation snippets (with `!Ref`, `!Sub`, `!GetAtt` tags), Prometheus/alertmanager configs, i18n translation files with long prose values, and a few JSON-Lines-like files (2+ lines each a one-line flow mapping like {"id":1,"name":"x"}). - /tmp/corpus/md/ : 40 files with .md (most), plus 8 .qmd and 6 .Rmd. Cover: READMEs (badges, install sections, code fences with languages, tables, nested lists, HTML blocks like

, reference-style links), CHANGELOGs (Keep a Changelog style, version headings, link reference definitions at the bottom), CONTRIBUTING guides, CODE_OF_CONDUCT, docs pages with admonitions, blockquotes, numbered lists, task lists, footnotes, setext headings (=== and ---), `*` and `+` bullets, headings with trailing #'s, emphasis with _ and __, long paragraphs with hard-wrapped lines at odd widths, very long lines, inline links with long URLs, images, autolinks, HTML comments, YAML front matter. Quarto .qmd files: YAML front matter (title/author/format/execute), ```{r} and ```{python} chunks with `#|` options (label, fig-cap, echo), callout divs (::: {.callout-note} ... :::), cross references (@fig-x), citations [@key], math $$...$$ blocks, tabsets. R Markdown .Rmd: front matter with `output:` and some with `editor_options:\n markdown:\n wrap: sentence` or `wrap: 72`, chunks like ```{r setup, include=FALSE}, inline r code `r 1+1`, long prose paragraphs with multiple sentences (including abbreviations like e.g., Dr., i.e.). - /tmp/corpus/py/ : 8 .py files. Some with consecutive `#|` comment blocks containing YAML (e.g. `#| title: x`, `#| tags: [a,b]`, nested keys), some with `# fmt: markdown` immediately before a triple-quoted string assignment or before a block of `# ` comments containing Markdown, normal Python code otherwise (functions, classes, docstrings). - /tmp/corpus/r/ : 6 .R files. Similar: roxygen `#'` comments, `#|` hashpipe blocks, `# fmt: markdown` before an r"(...)" raw string or a "..." string or a comment block. Make the documents realistic but messy (they will be formatted, so include things a formatter would change): inconsistent indentation (4-space and 2-space, sequences indented or not), extra spaces after colons, `[ a, b ]` flow lists with odd spacing, quoted values that don't need quotes, overly long prose lines (well over 80 chars), trailing whitespace in some places, multiple blank lines, mixed list markers, unaligned Markdown tables, etc. Vary sizes from ~20 to ~200 lines. Keep all content plain UTF-8 text; use LF line endings. Don't make any file invalid YAML (YAML files must parse as valid YAML 1.2), except you may include 2 YAML files whose flow collections span multiple lines. When done, reply with just the list of directories and file counts.

tools.name: Agent
tools.description:
Launch a new agent to handle complex, multi-step tasks. Each agent type has specific capabilities and tools available to it.

Available agent types are listed in <system-reminder> messages in the conversation.

When using the Agent tool, specify a subagent_type to select an agent: `"fork"` forks yourself (the fork inherits your full conversation context and always runs on your model — a `model` override is ignored); any other type — or omitting it — starts a fresh agent (general-purpose by default).

## When to use

A fresh agent costs more than it looks. It knows only what you put in the prompt, and you see only the summary it sends back — both handoffs drop detail, and neither of you can tell what the other missed. You can't watch it work, only wait or cancel. Its mistakes come back in the same confident register as its findings, and an agent handed your hypothesis tends to return it confirmed. Several at once spend tokens in a burst the user didn't ask for. Weigh those tokens against the accuracy they buy: the user pays for agents you did not need, and pays again for work you redo because you skipped one.

Reach for this when you have independent work to run in parallel, when the user asks for a side quest that shouldn't block your main thread, or when answering would mean reading across several files — delegate that and you keep the conclusion, not the file dumps.

Do the work yourself when it is a handful of tool calls or a lookup whose target you already know; don't delegate a check you could run inline. Delegate review only when you want a read that isn't anchored on yours — then give it the code, not your conclusion. Once you've delegated something, don't also run it yourself; wait for the result. When in doubt, don't spawn.

When you do spawn one, brief it like the peer it is: state the goal and what you have already ruled out, point it at the files and docs worth reading instead of retyping them, and keep the scope explicit and narrow. That brief is the only context it will have, so it is your first lever on every cost above — and if you cannot write a clear one, you do not understand the task well enough to hand it off.

A fork keeps its tool output out of your context. If you are the fork, execute directly — don't re-delegate.

- The agent's final message is returned to you as the tool result; it is not shown to the user — relay what matters.
- A previously spawned agent cannot be continued from here; every Agent call starts fresh (except subagent_type: "fork", which inherits your context).
- Each agent type's model, reasoning effort, and tools come from its definition (`.claude/agents/*.md` frontmatter or SDK `agents`).
- `isolation: "worktree"` gives the agent its own git worktree (auto-cleaned if unchanged).

description.description: A short (3-5 word) description of the task

prompt.description: The task for the agent to perform

subagent_type.description: The type of specialized agent to use for this task

model.description: Optional model override for this agent. Takes precedence over the agent definition's model frontmatter and the configured default subagent model. If omitted, uses the agent definition's model, else the default (inherits from the parent unless a default subagent model is configured). Ignored for subagent_type: "fork" — forks always inherit the parent model.

effort.description: Reasoning effort for this agent. Set this ONLY when the user, or instructions such as CLAUDE.md or a skill, explicitly ask that this agent or delegated work run at a specific effort level, never on your own judgment; otherwise omit it and the agent runs at its usual effort. Ignored for subagent_type: "fork": a fork runs at your own effort.

isolation.description: Isolation mode. "worktree" creates a temporary git worktree so the agent works on an isolated copy of the repo. "remote" launches the agent in a remote cloud environment (always runs in background; availability is gated).

tools.name: Bash
tools.description:
Executes a bash command and returns its output.

- `cd` carries to the next call only in the main session, if the command succeeds and ends inside the working directories. Outside them the shell returns to the start folder; otherwise it stays where it was. Prefer absolute paths — `cd` in a compound command can trigger a permission prompt. Shell state (env vars, functions) does not persist; the shell is initialized from the user's profile.
- Command output is displayed to you, not reliably to the user.
- `timeout` is in milliseconds: default 120000, max 600000 for a foreground command.

# Git
- Interactive flags (`-i`, e.g. `git rebase -i`, `git add -i`) are not supported in this environment.
- Use the `gh` CLI for GitHub operations (PRs, issues, API).
- GitHub notifies the owner of any `@name` written in a PR, issue, or comment. Write a bare `@name` only for a real login you mean to notify. Put roles, placeholders, and code (`@human`, `@reviewer`, `@types/node`) in backticks or drop the `@`, even when copied from project files.
- Commit or push only when the user asks. If on the default branch, branch first.
- End git commit messages and PR bodies with the attribution lines given in the conversation's system-reminder, when one is present.

timeout.description: Optional timeout in milliseconds (max 600000 for a foreground command)

description.description:
Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice. Never use words like "complex" or "risk" in the description - just describe what it does.

Say what the command does in plain words: do not echo the command's text, its flags, or file paths - the user reads this description, often without seeing the command.

For simple commands (git, npm, standard CLI tools), keep it brief (5-10 words):
- ls → "List files in current directory"
- git status → "Show working tree status"
- npm install → "Install package dependencies"

For commands that are harder to parse at a glance (piped commands, obscure flags, etc.), add enough context to clarify what it does:
- find . -name "*.tmp" -exec rm {} \; → "Find and delete all .tmp files recursively"
- git reset --hard origin/main → "Discard all local changes and match remote main"
- curl -s url | jq '.data[]' → "Fetch JSON from URL and extract data array elements"

dangerouslyDisableSandbox.description: Set this to true to dangerously override sandbox mode and run commands without sandboxing.

description.description:
Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice. Never use words like "complex" or "risk" in the description - just describe what it does.

Say what the command does in plain words: do not echo the command's text, its flags, or file paths - the user reads this description, often without seeing the command.

For simple commands (git, npm, standard CLI tools), keep it brief (5-10 words):
- ls → "List files in current directory"
- git status → "Show working tree status"
- npm install → "Install package dependencies"

For commands that are harder to parse at a glance (piped commands, obscure flags, etc.), add enough context to clarify what it does:

Invoke a skill.

A skill is a packaged set of instructions the user or project has set up for a particular kind of task (deploy steps, a review checklist, a repo-specific workflow). Available skills appear in a system-reminder listing with one-line descriptions. When the task at hand is one a listed skill covers, call this tool first — the skill's instructions load into the turn for you to follow in place of your default approach; some skills instead run in a subagent and return the finished result. A skill that runs in the background returns only the agent's name — its result arrives later as a task notification, so don't wait on it or invoke it again in the meantime. Users may also ask for one by name (`/<name>`, or "slash command"); that's a request to invoke it.

- `skill`: exact name from the listing, no leading slash. Plugin skills use `plugin:skill`. Directory-scoped skills are listed with a path prefix (`apps/web:deploy`); when both scoped and unscoped variants of a name exist, pick the one whose directory contains the files you're working on (most specific wins; unscoped otherwise).
- `args`: optional arguments to pass through.

Only names from the listing (or that the user typed explicitly) are valid. Built-in CLI commands (`/help`, `/clear`, …) aren't skills. If a `<command-name>` block is already present this turn, the skill is loaded — follow it directly rather than calling again.

input.content:
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main, 'release/**' ]
    paths-ignore:
      - 'docs/**'
      - "*.md"
  pull_request:
    branches:    [ main ]
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

env:
  PIP_DISABLE_PIP_VERSION_CHECK: "1"
  FORCE_COLOR: '1'
  PYTHONUNBUFFERED: 1

jobs:
    lint:
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        steps:
            - uses: actions/checkout@v4
            - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
              with:
                  python-version: "3.12"
                  cache: 'pip'
            - name: Install linters
              run: python -m pip install --upgrade pip && pip install ruff==0.6.9 mypy==1.11.2 types-requests types-PyYAML --no-cache-dir
            - name: Ruff
              run: ruff check . --output-format=github
            - name:   Mypy
              run: |
                mypy src/ \
                  --ignore-missing-imports \
                  --strict


    test:
      needs: lint
      name: test (${{ matrix.os }}, py${{ matrix.python-version }})
      runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
      strategy:
        fail-fast: false
        matrix:
          os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest,windows-latest]
          python-version: [ "3.9", "3.10", "3.11", "3.12", "3.13" ]
          exclude:
          - os: macos-latest
            python-version: "3.9"
          - os: windows-latest
            python-version: "3.9"
          include:
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            python-version: "3.13"
            coverage: true
      steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
          allow-prereleases: true
      - name: Install package
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -e ".[test]"
      - name: Run tests

name: "CodeQL & lint"

on:
  push:
    branches: [ "main" ]
  pull_request:
    # The branches below must be a subset of the branches above
    branches: [ "main" ]
  schedule:
    - cron: '17 3 * * 1'   # every Monday at 03:17 UTC


jobs:
  analyze:
    name: Analyze (${{ matrix.language }})
    runs-on: ${{ (matrix.language == 'swift' && 'macos-latest') || 'ubuntu-latest' }}
    timeout-minutes: ${{ (matrix.language == 'swift' && 120) || 360 }}
    permissions:
      security-events: write
      packages: read
      actions: read
      contents: read

    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
        - language: javascript-typescript
          build-mode: none
        - language: python
          build-mode: none
        - language: go
          build-mode: autobuild
    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v4

    - name: Initialize CodeQL
      uses: github/codeql-action/init@v3
      with:
        languages: ${{ matrix.language }}
        build-mode: ${{ matrix.build-mode }}
        queries: security-extended,security-and-quality

    - if: matrix.build-mode == 'manual'
      shell: bash
      run: |
        echo 'If you are using a "manual" build mode for one or more of the' \
          'languages you are analyzing, replace this with the commands to build' \
          'your code, for example:'
        echo '  make bootstrap'
        echo '  make release'
        exit 1

    - name: Perform CodeQL Analysis
      uses: github/codeql-action/analyze@v3
      with:
        category: "/language:${{matrix.language}}"

  golangci:
      name: golangci-lint
      runs-on: ubuntu-latest
      if: "!contains(github.event.head_commit.message, '[skip lint]')"
      steps:
          - uses: actions/checkout@v4
          - uses: actions/setup-go@v5
            with:
              go-version-file: 'go.mod'
              cache: false
          - name: golangci-lint
            uses: golangci/golangci-lint-action@v6
            with:

              args: --timeout=5m --config=.golangci.yml --issues-exit-code=1 --out-format=colored-line-number ./...
              only-new-issues: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

  markdown:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: DavidAnson/markdownlint-cli2-action@v17
        with:
          globs: |
            **/*.md
            !node_modules/**
            !CHANGELOG.md

name: Nightly

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 2 * * *"
  workflow_dispatch: {}

defaults:
  run:
    shell: bash

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    continue-on-error: ${{ matrix.experimental }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      max-parallel: 6
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest,
             macos-13,
             windows-latest]
        node: [ 18, 20, 22 ]
        experimental: [false]
        include: [
            {os: ubuntu-latest, node: 23, experimental: true},
            { os: ubuntu-24.04-arm, node: 22, experimental: true }
          ]
        exclude:
          - { os: macos-13, node: 18 }
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node }}
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci --no-audit --no-fund
      - run: npm test -- --reporter=dot --timeout=20000 --forbid-only --retries=2 --exit
      - name: Report failure
        if: failure() && github.event_name == 'schedule'
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          script: |
            const title = `Nightly failed on ${{ matrix.os }} / node ${{ matrix.node }}`;
            const body = [
              `Run: ${context.serverUrl}/${context.repo.owner}/${context.repo.repo}/actions/runs/${context.runId}`,
              '',
              'This issue was opened automatically.',
            ].join('\n');
            await github.rest.issues.create({ ...context.repo, title, body, labels: ['nightly', 'ci'] });

      matrix:
        config:
          - {os: macos-latest,   r: 'release'}

      - uses: r-lib/actions/setup-r@v2
        with:
          r-version: ${{ matrix.config.r }}
          http-user-agent: ${{ matrix.config.http-user-agent }}

        with:
          extra-packages: any::rcmdcheck, any::covr, local::.

      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
        id: deployment
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v4

name: "CodeQL & lint"

on:
  push:
    branches: [ "main" ]
  pull_request:
    # The branches below must be a subset of the branches above
    branches: [ "main" ]
  schedule:
    - cron: '17 3 * * 1'   # every Monday at 03:17 UTC


jobs:
  analyze:
    name: Analyze (${{ matrix.language }})
    runs-on: ${{ (matrix.language == 'swift' && 'macos-latest') || 'ubuntu-latest' }}
    timeout-minutes: ${{ (matrix.language == 'swift' && 120) || 360 }}
    permissions:
      security-events: write
      packages: read
      actions: read
      contents: read

    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
        - language: javascript-typescript
          build-mode: none
        - language: python
          build-mode: none
        - language: go
          build-mode: autobuild
    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v4

    - name: Initialize CodeQL
      uses: github/codeql-action/init@v3
      with:
        languages: ${{ matrix.language }}
        build-mode: ${{ matrix.build-mode }}
        queries: security-extended,security-and-quality

    - if: matrix.build-mode == 'manual'
      shell: bash
      run: |
        echo 'If you are using a "manual" build mode for one or more of the' \
          'languages you are analyzing, replace this with the commands to build' \
          'your code, for example:'
        echo '  make bootstrap'
        echo '  make release'
        exit 1

    - name: Perform CodeQL Analysis
      uses: github/codeql-action/analyze@v3
      with:
        category: "/language:${{matrix.language}}"

  golangci:
      name: golangci-lint
      runs-on: ubuntu-latest
      if: "!contains(github.event.head_commit.message, '[skip lint]')"
      steps:
          - uses: actions/checkout@v4
          - uses: actions/setup-go@v5
            with:
              go-version-file: 'go.mod'
              cache: false
          - name: golangci-lint
            uses: golangci/golangci-lint-action@v6
            with:
              version: v1.61
              args: --timeout=5m --config=.golangci.yml --issues-exit-code=1 --out-format=colored-line-number ./...
              only-new-issues: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

  markdown:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: DavidAnson/markdownlint-cli2-action@v17
        with:
          globs: |
            **/*.md
            !node_modules/**
            !CHANGELOG.md

name: Nightly

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 2 * * *"
  workflow_dispatch: {}

defaults:
  run:
    shell: bash

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    continue-on-error: ${{ matrix.experimental }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      max-parallel: 6
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest,
             macos-13,
             windows-latest]
        node: [ 18, 20, 22 ]
        experimental: [false]
        include: [
            {os: ubuntu-latest, node: 23, experimental: true},
            { os: ubuntu-24.04-arm, node: 22, experimental: true }
          ]
        exclude:
          - { os: macos-13, node: 18 }
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node }}
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci --no-audit --no-fund
      - run: npm test -- --reporter=dot --timeout=20000 --forbid-only --retries=2 --exit
      - name: Report failure
        if: failure() && github.event_name == 'schedule'
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          script: |
            const title = `Nightly failed on ${{ matrix.os }} / node ${{ matrix.node }}`;
            const body = [
              `Run: ${context.serverUrl}/${context.repo.owner}/${context.repo.repo}/actions/runs/${context.runId}`,
              '',
              'This issue was opened automatically.',
            ].join('\n');
            await github.rest.issues.create({ ...context.repo, title, body, labels: ['nightly', 'ci'] });

# Workflow derived from https://github.com/r-lib/actions/tree/v2/examples
# Need help debugging build failures? Start at https://github.com/r-lib/actions#where-to-find-help
on:
  push:
    branches: [main, master]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main, master]

name: R-CMD-check

permissions: read-all

jobs:
  R-CMD-check:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.config.os }}

    name: ${{ matrix.config.os }} (${{ matrix.config.r }})

    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        config:
          - {os: macos-latest,   r: 'release'}
          - {os: windows-latest, r: 'release'}
          - {os: ubuntu-latest,   r: 'devel', http-user-agent: 'release'}
          - {os: ubuntu-latest,   r: 'release'}
          - {os: ubuntu-latest,   r: 'oldrel-1'}

    env:
      GITHUB_PAT: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      R_KEEP_PKG_SOURCE: yes
      _R_CHECK_FORCE_SUGGESTS_: false

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: r-lib/actions/setup-pandoc@v2

      - uses: r-lib/actions/setup-r@v2
        with:
          r-version: ${{ matrix.config.r }}
          http-user-agent: ${{ matrix.config.http-user-agent }}
          use-public-rspm: true

      - uses: r-lib/actions/setup-r-dependencies@v2
        with:
          extra-packages: any::rcmdcheck, any::covr, local::.
          needs: check

      - uses: r-lib/actions/check-r-package@v2
        with:
          upload-snapshots: true
          build_args: 'c("--no-manual","--compact-vignettes=gs+qpdf")'

      - name: Test coverage
        if: runner.os == 'Linux' && matrix.config.r == 'release'
        run: |
          cov <- covr::package_coverage(
            quiet = FALSE,
            clean = FALSE,
            install_path = file.path(normalizePath(Sys.getenv("RUNNER_TEMP"), winslash = "/"), "package")
          )
          covr::to_cobertura(cov)
        shell: Rscript {0}

  worker:

    networks: [frontend]

kind: Deployment
metadata:

  namespace: shop
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: storefront

spec:
  replicas: 3
  revisionHistoryLimit: 5
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: storefront
  strategy:
    type: RollingUpdate
    rollingUpdate: {maxSurge: 25%, maxUnavailable: 0}
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: storefront
      annotations:
        prometheus.io/scrape: 'true'
        prometheus.io/port: "9102"
    spec:
      serviceAccountName: storefront
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        fsGroup: 10001
      containers:
      - name: app
        image: "ghcr.io/acme/storefront:2.14.0"
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        args: ["--port=8080", "--metrics-port=9102", '--log-format=json']
        ports:
        - containerPort: 8080
          name: http
        - {containerPort: 9102, name: metrics}
        env:
        - name: POD_NAME
          valueFrom:
            fieldRef:
              fieldPath: metadata.name
        - name: DATABASE_URL
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef: { name: storefront-db, key: url }
        - name: FEATURE_FLAGS
          value: "checkout-v2,new-search,  recommendations"
        envFrom:
          - configMapRef:
              name: storefront-config
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 250m
            memory: "256Mi"
          limits:
            memory: 512Mi
        readinessProbe:
          httpGet: { path: /readyz, port: http }
          initialDelaySeconds: 5
          periodSeconds: 10
        livenessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /healthz
            port: http
          failureThreshold: 3
        volumeMounts:
        - name: tmp
          mountPath: /tmp
      volumes:
      - name: tmp
        emptyDir: {}
---

kind: Service
metadata:
  name: storefront
  namespace: shop
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  selector:

  - host: shop.example.com

      - path: /

        backend:

            port:
              name: http

name: monitoring

services:
  prometheus:
    image: prom/prometheus:v2.54.1
    container_name: prometheus
    command:
      - '--config.file=/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml'
      - '--storage.tsdb.path=/prometheus'
      - "--storage.tsdb.retention.time=15d"
      - --web.enable-lifecycle
    volumes:
      - ./prometheus:/etc/prometheus:ro
      - prom_data:/prometheus
    ports: [ '9090:9090' ]
    restart: unless-stopped

  grafana:
    image: grafana/grafana-oss:11.2.0
    depends_on:
    - prometheus
    environment:
      GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_USER: ${GRAFANA_ADMIN_USER:-admin}
      GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_PASSWORD: ${GRAFANA_ADMIN_PASSWORD:?set GRAFANA_ADMIN_PASSWORD in .env}
      GF_USERS_ALLOW_SIGN_UP: "false"
      GF_INSTALL_PLUGINS: "grafana-clock-panel,grafana-piechart-panel"
    volumes:
    - grafana_data:/var/lib/grafana
    - ./grafana/provisioning:/etc/grafana/provisioning:ro
    ports:
    - "3001:3000"

  node-exporter:
    image: quay.io/prometheus/node-exporter:latest
    command: ['--path.rootfs=/host']
    pid: host
    network_mode: host
    volumes:
      - '/:/host:ro,rslave'

  cadvisor:
    image: gcr.io/cadvisor/cadvisor:v0.49.1
    privileged: true
    devices: [ /dev/kmsg ]
    volumes:
      - /:/rootfs:ro
      - /var/run:/var/run:ro
      - /sys:/sys:ro
      - /var/lib/docker/:/var/lib/docker:ro

volumes:
  prom_data: {}
  grafana_data: {}

---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: storefront
  namespace: shop
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: storefront
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: "shop"
    app.kubernetes.io/version: "2.14.0"
  annotations:
    deployment.kubernetes.io/revision: "17"
    kubernetes.io/change-cause: "Rolled out 2.14.0 to fix the checkout timeout regression introduced in 2.13.2 (see INC-4821 for the full post-incident review and follow-up actions)"
spec:
  replicas: 3
  revisionHistoryLimit: 5
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: storefront
  strategy:
    type: RollingUpdate
    rollingUpdate: {maxSurge: 25%, maxUnavailable: 0}
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: storefront
      annotations:
        prometheus.io/scrape: 'true'
        prometheus.io/port: "9102"
    spec:
      serviceAccountName: storefront
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        fsGroup: 10001
      containers:
      - name: app
        image: "ghcr.io/acme/storefront:2.14.0"
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        args: ["--port=8080", "--metrics-port=9102", '--log-format=json']
        ports:
        - containerPort: 8080
          name: http
        - {containerPort: 9102, name: metrics}
        env:
        - name: POD_NAME
          valueFrom:
            fieldRef:
              fieldPath: metadata.name
        - name: DATABASE_URL
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef: { name: storefront-db, key: url }
        - name: FEATURE_FLAGS
          value: "checkout-v2,new-search,  recommendations"
        envFrom:
          - configMapRef:
              name: storefront-config
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 250m
            memory: "256Mi"
          limits:
            memory: 512Mi
        readinessProbe:
          httpGet: { path: /readyz, port: http }
          initialDelaySeconds: 5
          periodSeconds: 10
        livenessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /healthz
            port: http
          failureThreshold: 3
        volumeMounts:
        - name: tmp
          mountPath: /tmp
      volumes:
      - name: tmp
        emptyDir: {}
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: storefront
  namespace: shop
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: storefront
  ports:
    - name: http
      port: 80
      targetPort: http
      protocol: TCP
---
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Ingress
metadata:
  name: storefront
  namespace: shop
  annotations:
    cert-manager.io/cluster-issuer: letsencrypt-prod
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/proxy-body-size: "16m"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/configuration-snippet: |
      more_set_headers "X-Frame-Options: DENY";
      more_set_headers "Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin";
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/server-snippet: "location ~* ^/(wp-admin|wp-login\\.php|xmlrpc\\.php) { return 404; }"
spec:
  ingressClassName: nginx
  tls:
  - hosts: [ shop.example.com, www.shop.example.com ]
    secretName: storefront-tls
  rules:
  - host: shop.example.com
    http:
      paths:
      - path: /
        pathType: Prefix
        backend:
          service:
            name: storefront
            port:
              name: http

apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: storefront-config
  namespace: shop
  labels: { app.kubernetes.io/name: storefront }
data:
  LOG_LEVEL: info
  CACHE_TTL_SECONDS: "300"
  ENABLE_TRACING: "true"
  application.properties: |
    server.port=8080
    spring.datasource.hikari.maximum-pool-size=20
    spring.jpa.open-in-view=false
    management.endpoints.web.exposure.include=health,info,prometheus
    # trailing comment inside the block
  nginx.conf: |
      worker_processes auto;
      events { worker_connections 1024; }
      http {
          include       mime.types;
          sendfile      on;
          keepalive_timeout  65;
          gzip on;
          gzip_types text/plain application/json application/javascript text/css;

          server {
              listen 8080;
              location / {
                  proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:3000;
                  proxy_set_header Host $host;
                  proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
              }
          }
      }
  motd.txt: >
    Welcome to the storefront staging cluster.
    Please do not run load tests here without
    announcing them in #shop-infra first.

  feature-flags.json: |-
    {
      "checkout-v2": true,
      "new-search": {"enabled": true, "rollout": 0.25},
      "recommendations": false
    }
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: fluent-bit-config
  namespace: logging
data:
  fluent-bit.conf: |
    [SERVICE]
        Flush         5
        Log_Level     info
        Parsers_File  parsers.conf

    [INPUT]
        Name              tail
        Path              /var/log/containers/*.log
        Tag               kube.*
        Mem_Buf_Limit     50MB

    [OUTPUT]
        Name  es
        Match *
        Host  ${ES_HOST}
        Port  9200
  parsers.conf: |
    [PARSER]
        Name   json
        Format json
        Time_Key time
        Time_Format %Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%L%z
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: storefront-db
  namespace: shop
type: Opaque
stringData:
  url: "postgres://app:s3cr3t@db.shop.svc.cluster.local:5432/app"

apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: CronJob
metadata:
  name: nightly-report
  namespace: analytics
  annotations:
    description: "Generates the nightly revenue report, uploads it to s3://acme-reports/nightly/ and posts a summary to the #revenue channel. Owned by the data-platform team; page them if it fails twice in a row."
spec:
  schedule: "30 1 * * *"
  timeZone: "Europe/Berlin"
  concurrencyPolicy: Forbid
  successfulJobsHistoryLimit: 3
  failedJobsHistoryLimit:     5
  jobTemplate:
    spec:
      backoffLimit: 2
      activeDeadlineSeconds: 3600
      template:
        spec:
          restartPolicy: OnFailure
          containers:
            - name: report
              image: ghcr.io/acme/reports:1.8.3
              command: [ "python", "-m", "reports.nightly" ]
              args:
                - --date=yesterday
                - "--output=s3://acme-reports/nightly/"
                - --notify-slack
              env:
                - name: AWS_REGION
                  value: eu-central-1
                - name: SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL
                  valueFrom:
                    secretKeyRef:
                      name: slack
                      key: webhook
              resources:
                requests: {cpu: 500m, memory: 1Gi}
                limits:   {memory: 2Gi}
          nodeSelector:
            workload: batch
          tolerations:
          - key: "dedicated"
            operator: "Equal"
            value: "batch"
            effect: "NoSchedule"

- name: Configure web servers
  hosts: webservers
  become: yes
  gather_facts: true
  vars:
    http_port:    80
    max_clients: 200
    app_user: "deploy"
    packages:

    - name: Update apt cache if needed
      ansible.builtin.apt:
        update_cache: yes
        cache_valid_time: 3600
      when: ansible_os_family == "Debian"

  tasks:
  - name: Install required packages
    ansible.builtin.package:
      name: "{{ item }}"
      state: present
    loop: "{{ packages }}"
    tags: [packages, setup]

  - name: Create application user
    ansible.builtin.user:
      name: "{{ app_user }}"
      shell: /bin/bash
      groups: www-data
      append: true

  - name: Write nginx site config
    ansible.builtin.template:
      src: templates/site.conf.j2
      dest: "/etc/nginx/sites-available/{{ inventory_hostname }}.conf"
      owner: root
      group: root
      mode: '0644'
      validate: 'nginx -t -c %s'
    notify:
      - Reload nginx

      dest: /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/{{ inventory_hostname }}.conf
      state: link
    notify: Reload nginx

---
# tasks file for roles/nginx
- name: Include OS-specific variables
  include_vars: "{{ item }}"
  with_first_found:
    - "{{ ansible_distribution }}-{{ ansible_distribution_major_version }}.yml"
    - "{{ ansible_os_family }}.yml"
    - default.yml

- name: Ensure nginx is installed
  package:
    name: nginx
    state: "{{ nginx_package_state | default('present') }}"
  register: nginx_install
  until: nginx_install is succeeded
  retries: 3
  delay: 5

- name: Create vhost directories
  file:
    path: "{{ item }}"
    state: directory
    owner: root
    mode: "0755"
  loop:
    - /etc/nginx/sites-available
    - /etc/nginx/sites-enabled
    - "{{ nginx_log_dir }}"

- name: Configure vhosts
  template:
    src: vhost.j2
    dest: "/etc/nginx/sites-available/{{ item.server_name }}.conf"
  loop: "{{ nginx_vhosts }}"
  loop_control:
    label: "{{ item.server_name }}"
  when: nginx_vhosts | length > 0
  notify: reload nginx

- name: Remove default site
  file: path=/etc/nginx/sites-enabled/default state=absent
  when: nginx_remove_default_vhost|bool
  notify:
  - reload nginx

- name: Generate dhparams (this can take a long time on small VMs, so we only do it once and cache the result in /etc/ssl/certs)
  command: openssl dhparam -out /etc/ssl/certs/dhparam.pem 2048
  args:
    creates: /etc/ssl/certs/dhparam.pem

- block:
    - name: Check nginx configuration
      command: nginx -t
      changed_when: false
    - name: Ensure nginx is started and enabled
      service: name=nginx state=started enabled=yes
  rescue:
    - name: Print the failing config
      debug:
        msg: "nginx -t failed with: {{ ansible_failed_result.stderr | default('unknown error') }}"
    - fail:
        msg: 'Aborting play, nginx config is broken'
  always:
    - debug: msg="nginx role finished"



- name: Set facts for later roles
  set_fact:
    nginx_configured: true
    nginx_vhost_names: "{{ nginx_vhosts | map(attribute='server_name') | list }}"

paths:

      operationId: listInvoices
      tags: [Invoices]
      parameters:
        - in: path
          name: customerId
          required: true
          schema: {type: string}
        - in: query
          name: status
          schema:
            type: string
            enum: [
              draft,
              open,
              paid,
              uncollectible,
              void
              ]
        - in: query
          name: created
          description: Filter by creation date. Accepts an object with any of the keys gt, gte, lt and lte, each holding a Unix timestamp in seconds.
          style: deepObject
          explode: true
          schema:
            type: object
            properties: {gt: {type: integer}, gte: {type: integer},
                         lt: {type: integer}, lte: {type: integer}}
      responses:
        "200":
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                required: [data,
                  has_more]
                properties:
                  data:
                    type: array
                    items: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Invoice" }
                  has_more: { type: boolean }
components:
  schemas:
    Money:
      type: object
      required: [amount, currency]
      properties:
        amount: { type: integer, description: "Amount in the smallest currency unit (e.g. cents)." }
        currency:
          type: string
          enum: [ EUR, USD, GBP, CHF, SEK, NOK, DKK, PLN,
                  CZK, HUF ]
    Invoice:
      type: object
      required: [ id, customer, status, total, lines ]
      properties:
        id: { type: string, example: in_1NqZ8x2eZvKYlo2C }
        customer: { type: string }
        status:
          type: string
          enum: [draft, open, paid, uncollectible, void]
        total: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/Money' }
        due_date: { type: string, format: date, nullable: true }
        lines:
          type: array
          items:
            type: object
            properties:

                type: array,
                items: { type: string },
                description: "IDs of tax rates applied to this line"

          type: object
          additionalProperties: { type: string }
          description: >-

            storing additional information about the object in a structured format.

---
- name: Configure web servers
  hosts: webservers
  become: yes
  gather_facts: true
  vars:
    http_port:    80
    max_clients: 200
    app_user: "deploy"
    packages:
      - nginx
      - "python3-pip"
      - git
      - ufw
    app_env:
      DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE: "mysite.settings.production"
      SECRET_KEY: "{{ vault_django_secret_key }}"
  vars_files:
    - vars/main.yml
    - "vars/{{ ansible_distribution | lower }}.yml"

  pre_tasks:
    - name: Update apt cache if needed
      ansible.builtin.apt:
        update_cache: yes
        cache_valid_time: 3600
      when: ansible_os_family == "Debian"

  tasks:
  - name: Install required packages
    ansible.builtin.package:
      name: "{{ item }}"
      state: present
    loop: "{{ packages }}"
    tags: [packages, setup]

  - name: Create application user
    ansible.builtin.user:
      name: "{{ app_user }}"
      shell: /bin/bash
      groups: www-data
      append: true

  - name: Write nginx site config
    ansible.builtin.template:
      src: templates/site.conf.j2
      dest: "/etc/nginx/sites-available/{{ inventory_hostname }}.conf"
      owner: root
      group: root
      mode: '0644'
      validate: 'nginx -t -c %s'
    notify:
      - Reload nginx

  - name: Enable site
    ansible.builtin.file:
      src: /etc/nginx/sites-available/{{ inventory_hostname }}.conf
      dest: /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/{{ inventory_hostname }}.conf
      state: link
    notify: Reload nginx

  - name: Open firewall ports
    community.general.ufw:
      rule: allow
      port: "{{ item.port }}"
      proto: "{{ item.proto | default('tcp') }}"
    loop:
      - { port: "22", proto: tcp }
      - { port: "{{ http_port }}" }
      - {port: "443"}
    when:
      - ansible_os_family == "Debian"
      - not (skip_firewall | default(false) | bool)

  - name: Show a long debug message
    ansible.builtin.debug:
      msg: "Deployed {{ app_user }} on {{ inventory_hostname }} ({{ ansible_default_ipv4.address | default('no ipv4') }}) running {{ ansible_distribution }} {{ ansible_distribution_version }}"
    when: debug_deploy is defined and debug_deploy

  handlers:
    - name: Reload nginx
      ansible.builtin.service:
        name: nginx
        state: reloaded

    - name:   Restart app
      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        name: "gunicorn@{{ app_user }}"
        state: restarted
        daemon_reload: true
      listen: "restart web stack"

- name: Configure database servers
  hosts: dbservers
  become: true
  roles:
    - role: geerlingguy.postgresql
      vars:
        postgresql_databases:
          - name: mysite
        postgresql_users:
          - name: mysite
            password: "{{ vault_db_password }}"
    - { role: common, tags: ['common'] }
...

---
# tasks file for roles/nginx
- name: Include OS-specific variables
  include_vars: "{{ item }}"
  with_first_found:
    - "{{ ansible_distribution }}-{{ ansible_distribution_major_version }}.yml"
    - "{{ ansible_os_family }}.yml"
    - default.yml

- name: Ensure nginx is installed
  package:
    name: nginx
    state: "{{ nginx_package_state | default('present') }}"
  register: nginx_install
  until: nginx_install is succeeded
  retries: 3
  delay: 5

- name: Create vhost directories
  file:
    path: "{{ item }}"
    state: directory
    owner: root
    mode: "0755"
  loop:
    - /etc/nginx/sites-available
    - /etc/nginx/sites-enabled
    - "{{ nginx_log_dir }}"

- name: Configure vhosts
  template:
    src: vhost.j2
    dest: "/etc/nginx/sites-available/{{ item.server_name }}.conf"
  loop: "{{ nginx_vhosts }}"
  loop_control:
    label: "{{ item.server_name }}"
  when: nginx_vhosts | length > 0
  notify: reload nginx

- name: Remove default site
  file: path=/etc/nginx/sites-enabled/default state=absent
  when: nginx_remove_default_vhost|bool
  notify:
  - reload nginx

- name: Generate dhparams (this can take a long time on small VMs, so we only do it once and cache the result in /etc/ssl/certs)
  command: openssl dhparam -out /etc/ssl/certs/dhparam.pem 2048
  args:
    creates: /etc/ssl/certs/dhparam.pem

- block:
    - name: Check nginx configuration
      command: nginx -t
      changed_when: false
    - name: Ensure nginx is started and enabled
      service: name=nginx state=started enabled=yes
  rescue:
    - name: Print the failing config
      debug:
        msg: "nginx -t failed with: {{ ansible_failed_result.stderr | default('unknown error') }}"
    - fail:
        msg: 'Aborting play, nginx config is broken'
  always:
    - debug: msg="nginx role finished"



- name: Set facts for later roles
  set_fact:
    nginx_configured: true
    nginx_vhost_names: "{{ nginx_vhosts | map(attribute='server_name') | list }}"

all:
  vars:
    ansible_user: deploy
    ansible_python_interpreter: /usr/bin/python3
    ntp_servers: [ 0.pool.ntp.org, 1.pool.ntp.org ]
  children:
    webservers:
      hosts:
        web1.example.com:
          ansible_host: 10.0.1.11
        web2.example.com:
          ansible_host: 10.0.1.12
          nginx_worker_processes: 4
        "web3.example.com":
          ansible_host:    10.0.1.13
    dbservers:
      hosts:
        db1.example.com: { ansible_host: 10.0.2.21, postgresql_role: primary }
        db2.example.com: { ansible_host: 10.0.2.22, postgresql_role: replica }
      vars:
        postgresql_version: "16"
        backup_window: "02:00-04:00"
    monitoring:
        hosts:
            mon1.example.com:
        vars:
            grafana_admin_password: "{{ vault_grafana_admin_password }}"
            alert_email: ops@example.com
    staging:
      children:
        webservers:
        dbservers:

variables:

  DOCKER_TLS_CERTDIR: "/certs"
  PIP_CACHE_DIR: "$CI_PROJECT_DIR/.cache/pip"
  IMAGE_TAG: $CI_REGISTRY_IMAGE:$CI_COMMIT_SHORT_SHA

default:
  image: python:3.12-slim
  interruptible: true
  cache:
    key:
      files: [ requirements.txt, requirements-dev.txt ]
    paths:
      - .cache/pip
      - .venv/

.python-setup: &python-setup
  before_script:
    - python -m venv .venv
    - source .venv/bin/activate
    - pip install -r requirements-dev.txt

.only-mr-and-main:
  rules: &mr_and_main_rules
    - if: '$CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "merge_request_event"'
    - if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == $CI_DEFAULT_BRANCH
    - if: $CI_COMMIT_TAG
      when: never

lint:
  stage: lint
  <<: *python-setup
  script:
    - ruff check .
    - ruff format --check .
  rules: *mr_and_main_rules

unit-tests:
  stage: test
  <<: *python-setup
  services:
    - name: postgres:16
      alias: db
  variables:
    POSTGRES_DB: test
    POSTGRES_USER: test
    POSTGRES_PASSWORD: "test"
    DATABASE_URL: "postgresql://test:test@db:5432/test"
  script:
    - pytest --junitxml=report.xml --cov=app --cov-report=term --cov-report=xml:coverage.xml
  coverage: '/(?i)total.*? (100(?:\.0+)?\%|[1-9]?\d(?:\.\d+)?\%)$/'
  artifacts:
    when: always
    reports:
      junit: report.xml
      coverage_report:
        coverage_format: cobertura
        path: coverage.xml
    expire_in: 1 week
  parallel:
    matrix:
      - PYTHON_VERSION: ["3.11", "3.12"]
        DB: [ postgres ]

build-image:
  stage: build
  image: docker:27
  services: [ "docker:27-dind" ]
  script:
    - echo "$CI_REGISTRY_PASSWORD" | docker login -u "$CI_REGISTRY_USER" --password-stdin "$CI_REGISTRY"
    - docker build --pull --build-arg BUILDKIT_INLINE_CACHE=1 --cache-from "$CI_REGISTRY_IMAGE:latest" -t "$IMAGE_TAG" -t "$CI_REGISTRY_IMAGE:latest" .
    - docker push "$IMAGE_TAG"
    - |
      if [ "$CI_COMMIT_BRANCH" = "$CI_DEFAULT_BRANCH" ]; then
        docker push "$CI_REGISTRY_IMAGE:latest"
      fi
  rules:
    - if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == $CI_DEFAULT_BRANCH
    - if: $CI_COMMIT_TAG

deploy-production:
  stage: deploy
  image: bitnami/kubectl:1.31
  environment:
    name: production
    url: https://shop.example.com
  script:
    - kubectl set image deployment/storefront app="$IMAGE_TAG" --namespace shop --record=false
    - kubectl rollout status deployment/storefront -n shop --timeout=300s
  rules:
    - if: $CI_COMMIT_TAG =~ /^v\d+\.\d+\.\d+$/
      when: manual
  needs: ["build-image", unit-tests]

version: 2.1

orbs:
  node: circleci/node@5.2.0
  aws-cli: circleci/aws-cli@4.1
  slack: circleci/slack@4.13.3

parameters:
  run-e2e:
    type: boolean
    default: false
  deploy-env:
    type: enum
    enum: ["staging", "production"]
    default: staging

executors:
  default:
    docker:
      - image: cimg/node:20.17
        auth:
          username: $DOCKERHUB_USER
          password: $DOCKERHUB_PASSWORD
    working_directory: ~/repo
    resource_class: medium+

commands:
  install-deps:
    description: "Install npm dependencies with caching keyed on the lockfile checksum"
    steps:
      - restore_cache:
          keys:
            - v3-deps-{{ checksum "package-lock.json" }}
            - v3-deps-
      - run: npm ci
      - save_cache:
          key: v3-deps-{{ checksum "package-lock.json" }}
          paths: [ node_modules ]

jobs:
  test:
    executor: default
    parallelism: 4
    steps:
      - checkout
      - install-deps
      - run:
          name: Run unit tests (split by timings)
          command: |
            TESTFILES=$(circleci tests glob "src/**/*.test.ts" | circleci tests split --split-by=timings)
            npx jest --ci --runInBand --reporters=default --reporters=jest-junit $TESTFILES
          environment:
            JEST_JUNIT_OUTPUT_DIR: ./reports/junit/
      - store_test_results:
          path: ./reports/junit/
      - store_artifacts: { path: coverage, destination: coverage }

  e2e:
    docker:
      - image: mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.47.2-jammy
    steps:
      - checkout
      - install-deps
      - run: npx playwright test --reporter=line,junit --workers=2 --retries=1 --project=chromium --project=firefox
      - store_artifacts:
          path: playwright-report

  deploy:
    executor: default
    parameters:
      env:
        type: string
    steps:
      - checkout
      - aws-cli/setup:
          role_arn: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/circleci-deploy
          region: eu-west-1
      - run:
          name: Deploy << parameters.env >>
          command: npm run deploy -- --env << parameters.env >> --confirm
      - slack/notify:
          event: fail
          template: basic_fail_1

workflows:
  build-test-deploy:
    jobs:
      - test
      - e2e:
          requires: [test]
          filters:
            branches:
              only: /^(main|release\/.*)$/
      - hold:
          type: approval
          requires:
            - test
          filters: { branches: { only: main } }
      - deploy:
          name: deploy-staging
          env: << pipeline.parameters.deploy-env >>
          requires: [ hold ]
          context:
            - aws-deploy
            - slack-secrets
  nightly:
    triggers:
      - schedule:
          cron: "0 4 * * 1-5"
          filters:
            branches:
              only:
                - main
    jobs: [test, e2e]

  jobs:
  - job: build

      matrix:

          imageName: 'ubuntu-latest'

    pool:

    steps:
    - task: UseDotNet@2

      displayName: 'dotnet build $(buildConfiguration)'
    - task: DotNetCoreCLI@2
      displayName: Run tests
      inputs:
        command: test
        projects: '**/*Tests.csproj'
        arguments: '--configuration $(buildConfiguration) --collect "XPlat Code Coverage" --logger trx'
        publishTestResults: true
    - ${{ if eq(variables['Build.SourceBranch'], 'refs/heads/main') }}:
      - task: PublishPipelineArtifact@1

# See https://pre-commit.com for more information
# See https://pre-commit.com/hooks.html for more hooks
default_language_version:
    python: python3.12
default_stages: [pre-commit, pre-push]
exclude: '^(docs/_build/|tests/fixtures/.*\.ya?ml$)'
fail_fast: false

ci:
  autofix_commit_msg: "style: auto fixes from pre-commit.com hooks"
  autoupdate_schedule: monthly
  skip: [mypy]

repos:
-   repo: https://github.com/pre-commit/pre-commit-hooks
    rev: v4.6.0
    hooks:
    -   id: trailing-whitespace
        args: [--markdown-linebreak-ext=md]
    -   id: end-of-file-fixer
    -   id: check-yaml
        args: ['--allow-multiple-documents', "--unsafe"]
        exclude: ^charts/.*/templates/
    -   id: check-added-large-files
        args: ['--maxkb=500']
    -   id: check-merge-conflict
    -   id: mixed-line-ending
        args: [ --fix=lf ]

-   repo: https://github.com/astral-sh/ruff-pre-commit
    rev: "v0.6.9"
    hooks:
    -   id: ruff
        args: [ --fix, --exit-non-zero-on-fix ]
    -   id: ruff-format

- repo: https://github.com/pre-commit/mirrors-mypy
  rev: v1.11.2
  hooks:
    - id: mypy
      additional_dependencies: [types-requests, "types-PyYAML", pydantic>=2.0]
      args: [--ignore-missing-imports, --no-warn-unused-ignores]

- repo: https://github.com/igorshubovych/markdownlint-cli
  rev: v0.42.0
  hooks:
  - id: markdownlint
    args: ["--fix", "--disable", "MD013", "MD033", "--"]

-   repo: local
    hooks:
      - id: check-changelog
        name: Check that CHANGELOG.md has an entry for this change
        entry: python scripts/check_changelog.py
        language: python
        files: ^(src/|CHANGELOG\.md$)
        pass_filenames: false
        stages: [pre-push]
      - id: no-print
        name: "Disallow print() in library code"
        entry: '(?<!\w)print\('
        language: pygrep
        types: [python]
        exclude: ^(scripts|tests)/

variables:

  IMAGE_TAG: $CI_REGISTRY_IMAGE:$CI_COMMIT_SHORT_SHA
  GIT_DEPTH: "20"

default:
  image: python:3.12-slim
  interruptible: true
  cache:
    key:
      files: [ requirements.txt, requirements-dev.txt ]
    paths:
      - .cache/pip
      - .venv/

.python-setup: &python-setup
  before_script:
    - python -m venv .venv
    - source .venv/bin/activate
    - pip install -r requirements-dev.txt

.only-mr-and-main:
  rules: &mr_and_main_rules
    - if: '$CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "merge_request_event"'
    - if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == $CI_DEFAULT_BRANCH
    - if: $CI_COMMIT_TAG
      when: never

lint:
  stage: lint
  <<: *python-setup
  script:
    - ruff check .
    - ruff format --check .
  rules: *mr_and_main_rules

unit-tests:
  stage: test
  <<: *python-setup
  services:
    - name: postgres:16
      alias: db
  variables:
    POSTGRES_DB: test
    POSTGRES_USER: test
    POSTGRES_PASSWORD: "test"
    DATABASE_URL: "postgresql://test:test@db:5432/test"
  script:
    - pytest --junitxml=report.xml --cov=app --cov-report=term --cov-report=xml:coverage.xml
  coverage: '/(?i)total.*? (100(?:\.0+)?\%|[1-9]?\d(?:\.\d+)?\%)$/'
  artifacts:
    when: always
    reports:
      junit: report.xml
      coverage_report:
        coverage_format: cobertura
        path: coverage.xml
    expire_in: 1 week
  parallel:
    matrix:
      - PYTHON_VERSION: ["3.11", "3.12"]
        DB: [ postgres ]

build-image:
  stage: build
  image: docker:27
  services: [ "docker:27-dind" ]
  script:
    - echo "$CI_REGISTRY_PASSWORD" | docker login -u "$CI_REGISTRY_USER" --password-stdin "$CI_REGISTRY"
    - docker build --pull --build-arg BUILDKIT_INLINE_CACHE=1 --cache-from "$CI_REGISTRY_IMAGE:latest" -t "$IMAGE_TAG" -t "$CI_REGISTRY_IMAGE:latest" .
    - docker push "$IMAGE_TAG"
    - |
      if [ "$CI_COMMIT_BRANCH" = "$CI_DEFAULT_BRANCH" ]; then
        docker push "$CI_REGISTRY_IMAGE:latest"
      fi
  rules:
    - if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == $CI_DEFAULT_BRANCH
    - if: $CI_COMMIT_TAG

deploy-production:

    - kubectl rollout status deployment/storefront -n shop --timeout=300s
  rules:
    - if: $CI_COMMIT_TAG =~ /^v\d+\.\d+\.\d+$/
      when: manual
  needs: ["build-image", unit-tests]

version: 2.1

orbs:
  node: circleci/node@5.2.0
  aws-cli: circleci/aws-cli@4.1
  slack: circleci/slack@4.13.3

parameters:
  run-e2e:
    type: boolean
    default: false
  deploy-env:
    type: enum
    enum: ["staging", "production"]
    default: staging

executors:
  default:
    docker:
      - image: cimg/node:20.17
        auth:
          username: $DOCKERHUB_USER
          password: $DOCKERHUB_PASSWORD
    working_directory: ~/repo
    resource_class: medium+

commands:
  install-deps:
    description: "Install npm dependencies with caching keyed on the lockfile checksum"
    steps:
      - restore_cache:
          keys:
            - v3-deps-{{ checksum "package-lock.json" }}
            - v3-deps-
      - run: npm ci
      - save_cache:
          key: v3-deps-{{ checksum "package-lock.json" }}
          paths: [ node_modules ]

jobs:
  test:
    executor: default
    parallelism: 4
    steps:
      - checkout
      - install-deps
      - run:
          name: Run unit tests (split by timings)
          command: |
            TESTFILES=$(circleci tests glob "src/**/*.test.ts" | circleci tests split --split-by=timings)
            npx jest --ci --runInBand --reporters=default --reporters=jest-junit $TESTFILES
          environment:
            JEST_JUNIT_OUTPUT_DIR: ./reports/junit/
      - store_test_results:
          path: ./reports/junit/
      - store_artifacts: { path: coverage, destination: coverage }

  e2e:
    docker:
      - image: mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.47.2-jammy
    steps:
      - checkout
      - install-deps
      - run: npx playwright test --reporter=line,junit --workers=2 --retries=1 --project=chromium --project=firefox
      - store_artifacts:
          path: playwright-report

  deploy:
    executor: default
    parameters:
      env:
        type: string
    steps:
      - checkout
      - aws-cli/setup:
          role_arn: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/circleci-deploy
          region: eu-west-1
      - run:
          name: Deploy << parameters.env >>
          command: npm run deploy -- --env << parameters.env >> --confirm
      - slack/notify:
          event: fail
          template: basic_fail_1

workflows:
  build-test-deploy:
    jobs:
      - test
      - e2e:
          requires: [test]
          filters:
            branches:
              only: /^(main|release\/.*)$/
      - hold:
          type: approval
          requires:
            - test
          filters: { branches: { only: main } }
      - deploy:
          name: deploy-staging
          env: << pipeline.parameters.deploy-env >>
          requires: [ hold ]
          context:
            - aws-deploy
            - slack-secrets
  nightly:
    triggers:
      - schedule:
          cron: "0 4 * * 1-5"
          filters:
            branches:
              only:
                - main
    jobs: [test, e2e]

trigger:
  branches:
    include:
    - main
    - releases/*
  paths:
    exclude: [ docs/*, README.md ]

pr:
  - main

pool:
  vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'

variables:
  - group: shared-secrets
  - name: buildConfiguration
    value: 'Release'
  - name: dotnetVersion
    value: "8.0.x"

stages:
- stage: Build
  displayName: Build and test
  jobs:
  - job: build
    strategy:
      matrix:
        linux:
          imageName: 'ubuntu-latest'
        windows:
          imageName: "windows-latest"
    pool:
      vmImage: $(imageName)
    steps:
    - task: UseDotNet@2
      inputs:
        packageType: sdk
        version: $(dotnetVersion)
    - script: dotnet restore && dotnet build --configuration $(buildConfiguration) --no-restore /p:ContinuousIntegrationBuild=true /warnaserror
      displayName: 'dotnet build $(buildConfiguration)'
    - task: DotNetCoreCLI@2
      displayName: Run tests
      inputs:
        command: test
        projects: '**/*Tests.csproj'
        arguments: '--configuration $(buildConfiguration) --collect "XPlat Code Coverage" --logger trx'
        publishTestResults: true
    - ${{ if eq(variables['Build.SourceBranch'], 'refs/heads/main') }}:
      - task: PublishPipelineArtifact@1
        inputs:
          targetPath: '$(Build.ArtifactStagingDirectory)'
          artifact: drop-$(Agent.OS)

- stage: Deploy
  dependsOn: Build
  condition: and(succeeded(), eq(variables['Build.SourceBranch'], 'refs/heads/main'))
  jobs:
    - deployment: DeployWeb
      environment: 'production'
      strategy:
        runOnce:
          deploy:
            steps:
              - download: current
                artifact: drop-Linux
              - task: AzureWebApp@1

                  appName: acme-storefront-prod
                  package: $(Pipeline.Workspace)/drop-Linux/**/*.zip

# See https://pre-commit.com for more information
# See https://pre-commit.com/hooks.html for more hooks
default_language_version:
    python: python3.12
default_stages: [pre-commit, pre-push]
exclude: '^(docs/_build/|tests/fixtures/.*\.ya?ml$)'
fail_fast: false

ci:
  autofix_commit_msg: "style: auto fixes from pre-commit.com hooks"
  autoupdate_schedule: monthly
  skip: [mypy]

repos:
-   repo: https://github.com/pre-commit/pre-commit-hooks
    rev: v4.6.0
    hooks:
    -   id: trailing-whitespace
        args: [--markdown-linebreak-ext=md]
    -   id: end-of-file-fixer
    -   id: check-yaml
        args: ['--allow-multiple-documents', "--unsafe"]
        exclude: ^charts/.*/templates/
    -   id: check-added-large-files
        args: ['--maxkb=500']
    -   id: check-merge-conflict
    -   id: mixed-line-ending
        args: [ --fix=lf ]

-   repo: https://github.com/astral-sh/ruff-pre-commit
    rev: "v0.6.9"
    hooks:
    -   id: ruff
        args: [ --fix, --exit-non-zero-on-fix ]
    -   id: ruff-format

- repo: https://github.com/pre-commit/mirrors-mypy
  rev: v1.11.2
  hooks:
    - id: mypy
      additional_dependencies: [types-requests, "types-PyYAML", pydantic>=2.0]
      args: [--ignore-missing-imports, --no-warn-unused-ignores]

- repo: https://github.com/igorshubovych/markdownlint-cli
  rev: v0.42.0
  hooks:
  - id: markdownlint
    args: ["--fix", "--disable", "MD013", "MD033", "--"]

-   repo: local
    hooks:
      - id: check-changelog
        name: Check that CHANGELOG.md has an entry for this change
        entry: python scripts/check_changelog.py
        language: python
        files: ^(src/|CHANGELOG\.md$)
        pass_filenames: false
        stages: [pre-push]
      - id: no-print
        name: "Disallow print() in library code"
        entry: '(?<!\w)print\('
        language: pygrep
        types: [python]
        exclude: ^(scripts|tests)/

frameworkVersion: '3'

provider:
  name: aws
  runtime: nodejs20.x
  stage: ${opt:stage, 'dev'}
  region: ${opt:region, 'eu-west-1'}
  memorySize: 1024
  timeout: 29
  logRetentionInDays: 14
  architecture: arm64
  environment:
    BUCKET_NAME: ${self:custom.bucketName}
    THUMBNAIL_SIZES: "128,256,512"
    STAGE: ${sls:stage}
    POWERTOOLS_SERVICE_NAME: ${self:service}
  iam:
    role:
      statements:
        - Effect: Allow
          Action:
            - s3:GetObject
            - s3:PutObject
          Resource: "arn:aws:s3:::${self:custom.bucketName}/*"
        - Effect: "Allow"
          Action: [ "sqs:SendMessage" ]
          Resource:
            Fn::GetAtt: [ ThumbnailQueue, Arn ]
  tags:
    team: media
    cost-center: "cc-1042"

custom:
  bucketName: acme-images-${sls:stage}
  esbuild:
    bundle: true
    minify: false
    sourcemap: true
    exclude: ['@aws-sdk/*']
  prune:
    automatic: true
    number: 3

functions:
  thumbnail:
    handler: src/handlers/thumbnail.handler
    description: Generates thumbnails for every image uploaded to the originals/ prefix and stores them under thumbnails/{size}/
    events:
      - s3:
          bucket: ${self:custom.bucketName}
          event: s3:ObjectCreated:*
          rules:
            - prefix: originals/
            - suffix: .jpg
          existing: true
  api:
    handler: src/handlers/api.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /images/{id}
          method: get
      - httpApi: 'POST /images'
  drain:
    handler: src/handlers/drain.handler
    reservedConcurrency: 2
    events:
      - sqs:
          arn:
            Fn::GetAtt:
              - ThumbnailQueue
              - Arn
          batchSize: 10
          maximumBatchingWindow: 5

resources:
  Resources:
    ThumbnailQueue:
      Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
      Properties:
        QueueName: ${self:service}-${sls:stage}-thumbnails
        VisibilityTimeout: 180
        RedrivePolicy:
          deadLetterTargetArn: !GetAtt ThumbnailDLQ.Arn
          maxReceiveCount: 5
    ThumbnailDLQ:
      Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
      Properties:
        MessageRetentionPeriod: 1209600
  Outputs:
    QueueUrl:
      Value: !Ref ThumbnailQueue
      Export:
        Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-QueueUrl"

plugins:
  - serverless-esbuild
  - serverless-prune-plugin
  - serverless-offline

package:
  individually: true
  patterns:
    - '!node_modules/**'
    - '!.git/**'
    - src/**

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  Network baseline: a VPC with two public and two private subnets spread across two
  Availability Zones, an Internet Gateway, and one NAT Gateway per AZ.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Description: An environment name that is prefixed to resource names
    Type: String
    Default: staging
    AllowedValues: [ dev, staging, production ]
  VpcCIDR:
    Description: Please enter the IP range (CIDR notation) for this VPC
    Type: String
    Default: 10.192.0.0/16
  PublicSubnet1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.192.10.0/24
  PublicSubnet2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.192.11.0/24
  PrivateSubnet1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.192.20.0/24
  PrivateSubnet2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.192.21.0/24

Conditions:
  IsProduction: !Equals [ !Ref EnvironmentName, production ]

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCIDR
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - { Key: Name, Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-igw" }

  InternetGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [ 0, !GetAZs '' ]
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1CIDR
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName} Public Subnet (AZ1)

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [ 1, !GetAZs  "" ]
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2CIDR
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName} Public Subnet (AZ2)'

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1CIDR
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false

  NatGateway1EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway1EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Condition: IsProduction
    Properties:
      AllocationId:
        Fn::GetAtt: [NatGateway1EIP, AllocationId]
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

  DefaultPublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  NoIngressSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: !Join [ "-", [ !Ref EnvironmentName, "no-ingress-sg" ] ]
      GroupDescription: "Security group with no ingress rule"
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

Outputs:
  VPC:
    Description: A reference to the created VPC
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-VPCID"
  PublicSubnets:
    Description: A list of the public subnets
    Value: !Join [ ",", [ !Ref PublicSubnet1, !Ref PublicSubnet2 ]]
  NatGatewayIds:
    Value: !If [ IsProduction, !Join [",", [!Ref NatGateway1, !Ref NatGateway2]], !Ref NatGateway1 ]

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Transform: AWS::Serverless-2016-10-31
Description: >
    orders-api

    SAM template for the orders API (API Gateway + Lambda + DynamoDB).

Globals:
    Function:
        Timeout: 10
        MemorySize: 256
        Runtime: python3.12
        Architectures: [ arm64 ]
        Tracing: Active
        Environment:
            Variables:
                TABLE_NAME: !Ref OrdersTable
                POWERTOOLS_LOG_LEVEL: INFO
    Api:
        TracingEnabled: true
        Cors:
            AllowMethods: "'GET,POST,OPTIONS'"
            AllowHeaders: "'Content-Type,Authorization'"
            AllowOrigin: "'*'"

Parameters:
    Stage:
        Type: String
        Default: dev
        AllowedValues:
            - dev
            - prod

Resources:
    OrdersFunction:
        Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
        Properties:
            CodeUri: orders/
            Handler: app.lambda_handler
            Policies:
                - DynamoDBCrudPolicy:
                      TableName: !Ref OrdersTable
                - Statement:
                      - Effect: Allow
                        Action: [ 'events:PutEvents' ]
                        Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:events:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:event-bus/default'
            Events:
                ListOrders:
                    Type: Api
                    Properties:
                        Path: /orders
                        Method: get
                CreateOrder:
                    Type: Api
                    Properties: { Path: /orders, Method: post }
                GetOrder:
                    Type: Api
                    Properties:
                        Path: /orders/{orderId}
                        Method: GET

    OrdersTable:
        Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
        DeletionPolicy: !If [IsProd, Retain, Delete]
        Properties:
            TableName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-orders-${Stage}"
            BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
            AttributeDefinitions:
                - AttributeName: pk
                  AttributeType: S
                - AttributeName: sk
                  AttributeType: S
            KeySchema:
                - { AttributeName: pk, KeyType: HASH }
                - { AttributeName: sk, KeyType: RANGE }
            PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
                PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: !If [ IsProd, true, false ]

    OrdersAlarm:
        Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
        Properties:
            AlarmDescription: !Sub "Errors in ${OrdersFunction} exceeded the threshold of 5 per minute for 3 consecutive minutes; check the X-Ray traces and the function logs."
            Namespace: AWS/Lambda
            MetricName: Errors
            Dimensions:
                - Name: FunctionName
                  Value: !Ref OrdersFunction
            Statistic: Sum
            Period: 60
            EvaluationPeriods: 3
            Threshold: 5
            ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold

Conditions:
    IsProd: !Equals [!Ref Stage, prod]

Outputs:
    OrdersApi:
        Description: "API Gateway endpoint URL for the Prod stage"
        Value: !Sub "https://${ServerlessRestApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/Prod/orders/"
    OrdersFunctionArn:
        Value: !GetAtt OrdersFunction.Arn
    OrdersFunctionRole:
        Value: !GetAtt [ OrdersFunctionRole, Arn ]

# .readthedocs.yaml
# Read the Docs configuration file
# See https://docs.readthedocs.io/en/stable/config-file/v2.html for details

# Required
version: 2

# Set the OS, Python version and other tools you might need
build:
  os: ubuntu-22.04
  tools:
    python: "3.12"
    # You can also specify other tool versions:
    # nodejs: "20"
  apt_packages:
    - graphviz
    - libenchant-2-dev
  jobs:
    post_checkout:
      - git fetch --unshallow || true
    pre_build:
      - python -m sphinx.ext.apidoc -o docs/api src/widgets --force --separate --module-first

# Build documentation in the "docs/" directory with Sphinx
sphinx:
   configuration: docs/conf.py
   fail_on_warning: true
   builder: dirhtml

# Optionally build your docs in additional formats such as PDF and ePub
formats:
   - pdf
   - epub

# Optional but recommended, declare the Python requirements required
# to build your documentation
# See https://docs.readthedocs.io/en/stable/guides/reproducible-builds.html
python:
   install:
   - requirements: docs/requirements.txt
   - method: pip
     path: .
     extra_requirements: [docs]

search:
  ranking:
    api/*: -1
    changelog.html: -3
  ignore: ['404.html', search.html]

# Welcome to Jekyll!
#
# This config file is meant for settings that affect your whole blog, values
# which you are expected to set up once and rarely edit after that. If you find
# yourself editing this file very often, consider using Jekyll's data files
# feature for the data you need to update frequently.
#
# For technical reasons, this file is *NOT* reloaded automatically when you use
# 'bundle exec jekyll serve'. If you change this file, please restart the server process.

title:   "Notes from the Workshop"
email: hello@example.com
description: >- # this means to ignore newlines until "baseurl:"
  Occasional writing about woodworking, small electronics, and the
  slow art of fixing things instead of replacing them.
baseurl: "" # the subpath of your site, e.g. /blog
url: "https://workshop.example.com" # the base hostname & protocol for your site, e.g. http://example.com
twitter_username: workshopnotes
github_username:  workshopnotes
author:
  name: "Robin Example"
  avatar: /assets/images/robin.jpg
  bio: "Maker, tinkerer, occasional writer. I build furniture out of reclaimed oak and spend far too much time reading datasheets for microcontrollers I will never actually use."
  links:
    - label: "Mastodon"
      icon: "fab fa-fw fa-mastodon"
      url: "https://mastodon.social/@workshopnotes"
    - label: GitHub
      icon: "fab fa-fw fa-github"
      url: https://github.com/workshopnotes

# Build settings
theme: minima
remote_theme: mmistakes/minimal-mistakes@4.26.2
plugins:
  - jekyll-feed
  - jekyll-seo-tag
  - jekyll-sitemap
  - jekyll-paginate
  - jekyll-include-cache

markdown: kramdown
kramdown:
  input: GFM
  syntax_highlighter: rouge
  hard_wrap: false

permalink: /:categories/:year/:month/:day/:title/
paginate: 8
paginate_path: /page:num/
timezone: Europe/Dublin

collections:
  projects:
    output: true
    permalink: /projects/:path/

defaults:
  # _posts
  - scope:
      path: ""
      type: posts
    values:
      layout: single
      author_profile: true
      read_time: true
      comments: true
      share: true
      related: true
  - scope: { path: "", type: projects }
    values: { layout: single, author_profile: false }

# Exclude from processing.
# The following items will not be processed, by default.
# Any item listed under the `exclude:` key here will be automatically added to
# the internal "default list".
exclude:
  - .sass-cache/
  - .jekyll-cache/
  - gemfiles/
  - Gemfile
  - Gemfile.lock
  - node_modules/
  - vendor/bundle/
  - vendor/cache/
  - vendor/gems/
  - vendor/ruby/
include: [ _pages ]

baseURL: https://example.org/
languageCode: en-us
title: "Field Notes"
theme: ["hugo-PaperMod"]
paginate: 10
enableRobotsTXT: true
buildDrafts: false
buildFuture: false
enableEmoji: true
pygmentsUseClasses: true
summaryLength: 40

minify:
  disableXML: true
  minifyOutput: true

params:
  env: production
  description: "Field Notes is a small blog about birdwatching in the north of England, the gear that works in the rain, and the gear that does not."
  author: [ "Sam Example" ]
  defaultTheme: auto
  ShowReadingTime: true
  ShowShareButtons: true
  ShowPostNavLinks: true
  ShowBreadCrumbs: true
  ShowCodeCopyButtons: false
  ShowToc: true
  homeInfoParams:
    Title: "Hi there — welcome"
    Content: >
      Notes, sightings and the occasional rant about binoculars.
      New posts roughly every other Sunday.
  socialIcons:
    - name: rss
      url: "/index.xml"
    - { name: github, url: "https://github.com/example" }
  cover:
    hidden: true
    hiddenInList: true
  editPost:
    URL: "https://github.com/example/field-notes/tree/main/content"
    Text: "Suggest changes"
    appendFilePath: true

menu:
  main:
    - identifier: archives
      name: Archives
      url: /archives/
      weight: 10
    - identifier: tags
      name: Tags
      url: /tags/
      weight: 20
    - identifier: search
      name: Search
      url: /search/
      weight: 30

outputs:
  home: [ HTML, RSS, JSON ]

markup:
  goldmark:
    renderer:
      unsafe: true
    extensions:
      footnote: true
      typographer:
        disable: false
  highlight:
    noClasses: false
    style: monokai
    lineNos: false
    codeFences: true
    guessSyntax: true

taxonomies:
  tag: tags
  category: categories
  series: series

languages:
  en:
    languageName: English
    weight: 1
  de:
    languageName: Deutsch
    weight: 2
    title: Feldnotizen
    params:
      description: "Feldnotizen ist ein kleiner Blog über Vogelbeobachtung im Norden Englands, über Ausrüstung, die im Regen funktioniert, und über Ausrüstung, die es nicht tut."

project:
  type: website
  output-dir: _site
  render:
    - "*.qmd"
    - "!drafts/"
  resources: [ "data/*.csv", images/ ]

website:
  title: "Reproducible Research Notes"
  site-url: https://notes.example.edu
  repo-url: https://github.com/example/rr-notes
  repo-actions: [edit, issue]
  page-navigation: true
  search:
    location: navbar
    type: overlay
  navbar:
    background: primary
    left:
      - href: index.qmd
        text: Home
      - text: "Tutorials"
        menu:
          - tutorials/01-intro.qmd

          - text: "Advanced: modelling"
            href: tutorials/03-models.qmd
      - about.qmd
    right:
      - icon: github
        href: https://github.com/example/rr-notes
        aria-label: GitHub
  sidebar:
    style: "docked"
    contents:
      - section: "Tutorials"
        contents: tutorials/*
      - section: Reference
        contents:
          - reference/glossary.qmd
          - reference/faq.qmd
  page-footer:
    left: "Content licensed under CC BY 4.0. Code licensed under MIT unless noted otherwise."
    right:
      - icon: rss

bibliography: references.bib
csl: apa.csl

  html:
